description: This PHP class 'RunMigrationClassCommand' defines a console command within the OrangeHRM system for executing database migration classes. It handles command configuration, validation of migration class subclasses, execution of the migration, and updates configuration with the new version.

classes.name: RunMigrationClassCommand
classes.description: A console command class for executing specified migration classes within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command's description, help text, and required argument 'className'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Handles the execution flow: checks installation, validates the migration class, initializes the kernel, runs the migration, updates config with version, and reports success or errors.
